concept: Taking responsibility when a group plan doesn't work out, instead of blaming others
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character's group plan doesn't work out, and the character owns their part instead of blaming teammates
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the group feel about the character after they took responsibility?
exercise.practice: Student names a time a group plan they were part of didn't work, and what they could own about it

assessment.success_marker: student names something they could own, not just what others did wrong
